title: Galaxygen
body:
This Plugin can generate Galaxy like structures. There are multiple different Galaxy types and each of them is configurable.

You get the best results when generating big galaxies.

Your PC and server both have to be really strong to run this.

[Download world with 8x pregenerated zigzag galaxy](https://streamshare.wireway.ch/download/fjt4ceo2)

[Download .obj file for rendering with blender](https://streamshare.wireway.ch/download/d6pvkj12)

Command: /galaxy <galaxyType> [# arms] [# particles] [size (multiplier)] [pitch] [yaw]

Commands with their results are available in the Gallery Tab

Available types:
- zigzag
- spiral
- barred
- elliptical
- irregular
- lenticular
